aiSummary.summary: Multiple vulnerabilities exist in the S/MIME decryption functionality of Cisco Secure Email. These flaws could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to recover plaintext from encrypted emails.
aiSummary.whyItMatters: Attackers could exploit these vulnerabilities to compromise the confidentiality of sensitive email communications.
aiSummary.action: Check vendor advisories and apply available software updates or patches.
